# Handoff State & Manifest JSON Schemas (`v1`)

`handoff_ops.py` uses two JSON files inside `.handoff/` to separate mechanical workspace facts (`manifest.json`) from agent-authored session context (`state.json`).

---

## 1. `.handoff/manifest.json` (Generated by `handoff_ops.py capture`)

Do not hand-edit this file; run `handoff_ops.py capture` so SHA-256 digests and git `HEAD` SHAs reflect ground truth on disk.

```json
{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "captured_at": "2026-11-09T09:30:00Z",
  "primary_workspace": "content",
  "workspaces": [
    {
      "name": "content",
      "path": "~/code/non-code/content",
      "is_git": true,
      "branch": "chore/restructure",
      "head_sha": "40-char-git-sha",
      "head_subject": "Last commit subject (secret-redacted)",
      "recent_commits": ["abc1234567 Commit subject"],
      "dirty_files": [{"status": "M", "path": "index.html"}],
      "dirty_total": 1,
      "watched_digests": {
        "index.html": {
          "sha256": "64-char-hex-digest",
          "size": 18420
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

---

## 2. `.handoff/state.json` (Authored by Outgoing Agent, Verified by `validate`)

Every field below is checked by `handoff_ops.py validate`:

```json
{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "title": "Short descriptive title of the active handoff",
  "mission": "One-sentence summary of the overarching goal + current deliverable.",
  "active_focus": {
    "summary": "Exact file(s), section(s), or problem currently in flight.",
    "primary_workspace": "content",
    "active_files": [
      "antigravity-creative-stack/blogs/01-agentic-audio-studio-blog.md",
      "antigravity-creative-stack/codelabs/01-agentic-audio-studio/index.lab.md"
    ]
  },
  "completed": [
    {
      "item": "What was finished and verified in this or prior sessions",
      "artifacts": [
        "antigravity-creative-stack/codelabs/01-agentic-audio-studio/index.lab.md"
      ],
      "verification": "Exact command + result (e.g., validate_codelab.cjs PASS, Fog 11.35)"
    }
  ],
  "locked_decisions": [
    {
      "decision": "Specific user constraint, naming rule, URL correction, or design choice",
      "rationale": "Why this rule exists so the next agent does not undo or violate it"
    }
  ],
  "next_actions": [
    {
      "step": "Action #1 for the incoming agent to execute or confirm first",
      "command_or_prompt": "Exact command or action to run",
      "expected_outcome": "Observable result proving Action #1 succeeded"
    }
  ],
  "open_questions": [
    "Optional pending user input or external dependency (leave [] if none)"
  ],
  "suggested_skills": [
    {
      "skill": "codelab",
      "why": "Enforces 7-phase Google Codelab rules and readability checks"
    }
  ],
  "resume_verification": [
    "python3 ~/.agents/skills/handoff/scripts/handoff_ops.py status --root ."
  ]
}
```

### Validation Rules (`handoff_ops.py validate`)
- `schema_version` MUST equal `1`.
- `title`, `mission`, `active_focus.summary`, and `active_focus.primary_workspace` MUST be non-empty strings.
- `active_focus.active_files`, `next_actions`, and `resume_verification` MUST be non-empty lists.
- Each item in `next_actions` MUST provide non-empty `step`, `command_or_prompt`, and `expected_outcome` strings.
- All string values are scanned against `SECRET_PATTERNS` (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google `AIza`/`ya29`, GitHub `ghp_`, AWS `AKIA`, Slack `xox*`, PEM private keys). Any match exits `1`.
- With `--check-paths`, every path in `active_focus.active_files` and `completed[*].artifacts` must resolve to an existing file or directory inside one of the workspaces in `manifest.json` (or `~`-prefixed path).
